notes: Homonym: shares consonants עות with H5791 ("make crooked; subvert justice"), a separate, unrelated Strong's entry already in this dataset. Per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹), this root is עות¹ and H5791 has been retroactively relabeled עות² in this same batch. (Strong's own entry for H5790 says it is "for H5789" -- a variant spelling of the immediately preceding entry, not of H5791 -- so that relationship is etymological only and doesn't affect the root-key here.)
